corrections.corrected_text: On the location Five-Pointed Sun, change the When Permanently closed text to "This location cannot be permanently closed unless all other locations are closed."
corrections.issue: Since the location Five-Pointed Sun can't be permanently closed, to win a scenario that uses it, you need to have one character temporarily close that location while another character battles the villain elsewhere. So how do you win when you have only one character playing?
